## Purpose and Entry Points
OpenSpace is a local-first skill-management and execution layer for AI agents: it runs tasks, retrieves local/cloud skills, records outcomes, and conditionally evolves skills. Python is the primary runtime; public processes include CLI, MCP server, dashboard API, gateway, and embedded Python API.
- `openspace/application.py`
- `openspace/entrypoints/cli/main.py`
- `openspace/entrypoints/mcp/server.py`
- `openspace/entrypoints/dashboard/server.py`

## Shared Execution Runtime
All invocation surfaces converge on a shared runtime that owns requests, sessions/workspaces, event publication, scheduling, turn execution, and finalization. This is the main control boundary: UI/host adapters submit execution requests rather than implementing agent logic themselves.
- `openspace/runtime/app.py`
- `openspace/runtime/execution_scheduler.py`
- `openspace/runtime/turn_runner.py`
- `openspace/runtime/session_runtime.py`

## Agent and Turn Loop
The agent layer builds context, injects/retrieves skills, calls the configured LLM, interprets tool turns, and applies stop/compaction/session policies. Coordinator and multi-agent modules support delegated/background work. Conversation history, tool results, and task state feed subsequent turns and recoverable sessions.
- `openspace/agents/grounding_agent.py`
- `openspace/agents/turns/loop.py`
- `openspace/agents/turns/model_call_controller.py`
- `openspace/agents/coordinator.py`

## Tool Grounding, Security, and Permissions
A unified grounding client abstracts local and remote tools. Providers cover shell, MCP, GUI/computer use, and web; tool execution is gated by permission engines, shell/path validation, and optional platform sandboxing. This is the safety boundary between model-directed actions and host resources.
- `openspace/grounding/core/grounding_client.py`
- `openspace/grounding/core/tool_executor.py`
- `openspace/grounding/core/permissions/engine.py`
- `openspace/services/sandbox/manager.py`

## Skill Registry, Retrieval, and Persistent Evidence
Skills are discovered from configured directories and represented with stable IDs, safety checks, local metadata, lineage, and quality records. Hybrid ranking selects relevant skills; runtime/tool/session evidence is assembled into packets used for quality decisions and later evolution. Local persistence is SQLite-oriented; project state conventionally lives under `.openspace`.
- `openspace/skill_engine/registry.py`
- `openspace/skill_engine/skill_ranker.py`
- `openspace/skill_engine/store.py`
- `openspace/skill_engine/evidence/packet_builder.py`

## Controlled Skill Evolution
Post-run analysis detects signals and proposes FIX, DERIVED, or CAPTURED changes. Admission, authoring, validation, behavioral evaluation, and auditing constrain writes; candidates may remain audit-only, and trust/enablement are separate lifecycle controls. Successful evolved skills re-enter the registry and retrieval flow.
- `openspace/skill_engine/evolution/engine.py`
- `openspace/skill_engine/evolution/admission.py`
- `openspace/skill_engine/evolution/validator.py`
- `openspace/skill_engine/evolver.py`

## External Boundaries and Clients
LLM access is centralized behind a LiteLLM-oriented client. Cloud services provide authenticated skill upload/download/search, embeddings, quality/trace telemetry, and redaction; cloud discovery is distinct from local execution/import. MCP supports stdio and network transports; communication gateway adapters connect Feishu and WhatsApp, with the latter including a Node bridge.
- `openspace/llm/client.py`
- `openspace/cloud/client.py`
- `openspace/grounding/backends/mcp/client.py`
- `openspace/communication/gateway_runtime.py`

## User Interfaces
The TypeScript Ink TUI communicates with Python through an NDJSON bridge/protocol and renders streamed runtime events, permissions, transcripts, and background tasks. The separate React/Vite dashboard consumes the dashboard API to browse skill classes, lineage, workflow records, and evolution details.
- `apps/tui/src/index.tsx`
- `apps/tui/src/bridge/protocol.ts`
- `apps/dashboard/src/main.tsx`
- `apps/dashboard/src/api/client.ts`
